prerequisites: Average knowledge of upper secondary mathematics

learning_outcomes.text: Master differential and integral calculus with one variable.
Find independent problem-solving guidance in provided documents.
Transfer knowledge to new problem formulations.
Process tasks in a structured and creative way.

syllabus_topics: Differential calculus (limit considerations, differential quotient, differentiability, differentiation rules, higher derivatives, curve discussion, extremum problems with side conditions)
Integral calculus (basic integrals, integration rules and methods, multiple integrals)
Vector calculus (vector addition, unit and direction vectors, scalar and vector product, coordinate transformation)
Extraction of mathematical relationships from problems in mechanics, physics, electrical engineering
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a passed written exam. The weighting of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
